accuracy.body_dimensions: Published Samsung chassis dimensions excluding camera modules. Historical Fold3/4 and Flip3/4 thickness range retained in published_spec; closed wedge angle inferred from that range.
accuracy.screen_resolution: Published native panel pixels; orientation follows portrait cover/inner in the physical open chassis. ADB feed maps through full native UVs.
accuracy.screen_geometry: Active full rectangle from published diagonal/native aspect, fitted within chassis. Rounded corners, bezels, cover folder contour, camera cutouts are photo estimates; not CAD.
accuracy.camera_geometry: Lens and flash centres/diameters from source icon measurements of Samsung artwork. Samsung-specific individual rings/capsule, no Pixel bar. Protrusions and optical internals are estimates.
accuracy.finishes: Official standard and online-exclusive finish names; approximate sampled sRGB. Bespoke combinations and special editions excluded.
accuracy.hinge: Rigid articulated panels with physically positioned axes; external barrel dimensions/curves estimated. Internal multi-link and flexible OLED bend not simulated.
accuracy.omissions: Ports, grille perforations, antenna seams and internal hinge linkages.
